group.name: dbstudio
group.title: DB Studio
group.description: Controls access to DB Studio inside the Admin CP.

settings.name: dbstudio_enabled
settings.title: Enable DB Studio
settings.description: Turn DB Studio on or off. When disabled, the module refuses every request, including administrators with permission.

settings.name: dbstudio_allowed_admins
settings.title: Additional Allowed Administrator UIDs
settings.description: Comma-separated administrator user IDs that may use the database manager in addition to administrators who hold the Admin CP permission. Leave empty to rely on the permission only. Super administrators always have access.

settings.name: dbstudio_allowed_ips
settings.title: Allowed IP Addresses
settings.description: One IPv4 or IPv6 address or CIDR range per line. Leave empty to allow every IP address. Example: 203.0.113.7 or 2001:db8::/32.

settings.name: dbstudio_auto_login
settings.title: Database Login Mode
settings.description: Automatic uses the database credentials from inc/config.php. Manual shows the DB Studio login form so the administrator types the database credentials.
settings.optionscode:
select
1=Automatic (use inc/config.php)
0=Manual (show DB Studio login form)

settings.name: dbstudio_theme
settings.title: DB Studio Theme
settings.description: Choose the color theme used inside the embedded DB Studio page.

settings.name: dbstudio_bind_ip
settings.title: Bind Session To IP Address
settings.description: Invalidate the database manager session when the client IP address changes. Disable this only if the administrator uses a connection whose IP address changes often.

settings.name: dbstudio_idle_timeout
settings.title: Idle Timeout (Minutes)
settings.description: Close the database manager session after this many minutes without a request. Set to 0 to disable the idle timeout. The Administrator must open the module again after a timeout.

settings.name: dbstudio_single_session
settings.title: One Session Per Administrator
settings.description: When enabled, opening the database manager closes any other database manager session for the same administrator.

settings.name: dbstudio_audit_log
settings.title: Write Audit Log
settings.description: Record database manager access and session events in the database for review.

settings.name: dbstudio_log_retention
settings.title: Audit Log Retention (Days)
settings.description: Delete audit log entries older than this many days. Set to 0 to keep every entry.
